name: karaokepitch-studio
description: Real-time YouTube karaoke pitch shifter, A/V sync adjuster, and offline player for Windows and Android.
author: Sadeesha Sathsara

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:electron
scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -k "npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run build:electron && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.build:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:web && cap sync android
